name: drift-check
title_zh: 上线后自动比对设计稿，揪出悄悄跑偏的界面
tagline_zh: 开发说「按稿做的」，你看着却不像。它直接拿线上实现和 /design-proto 里的原型逐帧比对。
tagline_en: Dev says it matches the mock; your eyes say no. It diffs the live build against the design proto and lists every.
desc_en: Compares the actual shipped implementation against the design mocks or prototypes it was based on (from /design-proto or /quick-proto) and reports where they have diverged. Primarily for developers validating that what shipped matches what was agreed, but usable by anyone checking alignment. Use when asking whether the built feature still matches the design it came from.
why_zh: 不是截图对比，而是读实现代码与原型结构，按组件粒度报告偏差。把「感觉不对」变成可追踪的差异条目。
why_en: Not pixel-peeping — it compares implementation structure against the prototype at component level, turning vague unease into a.
limit_zh: 只认仓库内 /design-proto 或 /quick-proto 目录下的原型；线上产物需可本地构建。
limit_en: Only works with protos in /design-proto or /quick-proto; shipped build must be locally runnable. Flags structural drift only — no aesthetic judgment.
title_en: Diff shipped UI against design mocks to catch drift
